description: Source code implementing 'git remote' command functionalities, including remote management, fetching, pruning, and configuration handling.

methods.name: fetch_remote
methods.description: Fetches updates from a remote repository by name.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new remote with specified options and configuration.

methods.name: mv
methods.description: Renames an existing remote, handling configuration and references.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes a remote and associated references and configuration.

methods.name: clear_push_info
methods.description: Clears push info data structures.

methods.name: free_remote_ref_states
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for remote reference states.

methods.name: append_ref_to_tracked_list
methods.description: Appends references to tracked list if tracking info is available.

methods.name: get_remote_ref_states
methods.description: Retrieves remote reference states, including refs, heads, and push states.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays information about remotes, including URLs, branches, and push/pull status.

methods.name: set_head
methods.description: Sets or deletes the remote HEAD reference.

methods.name: prune_remote
methods.description: Prunes stale references from a remote.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Performs pruning on specified remotes.

methods.name: get_remote_default
methods.description: Checks if remote.default is set in config.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates remote references by fetching and optionally pruning.

methods.name: remove_all_fetch_refspecs
methods.description: Removes all fetch refspecs for a remote.

methods.name: add_branches
methods.description: Adds branch refspecs for a remote.

methods.name: set_remote_branches
methods.description: Sets or updates remote branch refspecs.

methods.name: set_branches
methods.description: Configures remote branches with options.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Retrieves URLs for a remote.

methods.name: set_url
methods.description: Sets or modifies URLs for a remote.

methods.name: cmd_remote
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git remote' subcommands, dispatching to specific functions.
